query:
SELECT
        id,
        serial_number,
        last_ping,
        CASE
        WHEN last_ping > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 minutes'
        THEN true
        ELSE false
        END AS is_healthy
        FROM device
        WHERE
            CASE
                WHEN $1 ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (length($1) < 10 OR (length($1) = 10 AND $1 <= '2147483647')) THEN
                    id = $1::int4
                ELSE
                    serial_number = $1
            END
